mapper.select: SELECT pd.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HEALTH_RECORD r WHERE r.CARD_CODE = pd.CARD_CODE AND r.COLLECTED_AT >= #{from} AND r.COLLECTED_AT < #{to}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END UPLOADED FROM POS_PRESENCE_DAILY pd JOIN DEVICE d ON d.CARD_CODE = pd.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1 LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = pd.CARD_CODE WHERE pd.STAT_DATE = #{statDate} ORDER BY p.DEPT, p.PERSON_NAME, pd.CARD_CODE
